Based on the provided chest X-ray, there is no obvious pulmonary atelectasis in either the right or left lung. The lung fields appear relatively clear, and there are no significant consolidations or opacities that would suggest atelectasis.

However, it's important to note that a single image is not sufficient to rule out atelectasis completely. Atelectasis can be subtle and may not be apparent on a single view.

To confirm the absence of atelectasis, a lateral decubitus view of the chest would be helpful. This view can help to identify small areas of atelectasis that may not be visible on the PA view.

In summary, based on the provided image, there is no obvious atelectasis. However, a lateral decubitus view would be recommended for further evaluation.
